Let \(p\in[0,1]\).
A valid weight distribution means non-negative real numbers \(w_1,\ldots,w_m\) with \(\sum_{i=1}^m w_i=1\).
Let \(v_1,\ldots,v_m\) be i.i.d.\ Bernoulli\((p)\) random variables.

The inequality
\[
\Pr\Big[\sum_{i=1}^m w_i v_i\geq p\Big]\geq p
\]
holds for all valid weight distributions if and only if \(p=1/k\) for some integer \(k\ge 1\), or \(p=0\).
